opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits paid participation by offering packages from $100 to $5,000, with the selected package determining the number of tokens received. It then links that purchase to mining: viewers buy a package, obtain tokens, and send them to a mining operation. The invitation is explicit—“buy one of our packages get some tokens get some coins”—and the presentation adds optimistic financial incentives through direct sales, commissions, network and bonus commissions. It also describes a system for “explaining training and enrolling” a team, showing that sharing the offer and building participation are part of the opportunity. This is a solicitation to obtain tokens, mine coins, pursue appreciation and build wealth, not independent reporting or neutral cryptocurrency education.
